item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 10/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the northeast monsoon over the coast of southern China moderating, temperatures will rise over the region in the next couple of days. An easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week. There will be a few rain patches over the region. The easterly airstream will be gradually replaced by a continental airstream over the weekend. The weather will be mainly fine over the coast of southern China. Besides, the area of low pressure over the seas east of the Philippines may develop into a tropical cyclone, and will move towards the vicinity of the Philippines in the next couple of days. However, there are uncertainties in its subsequent intensity and movement.
